description: A poll's results. For choice and scale questions each answer's share per model per run, for number and scale questions each model's mean, each with its 95% repeat range (low, high). Pooled over wordings, each wording counts once and the range combines each wording's own sampling error; the wording range (wording_low, wording_high) says how far the wordings' own figures lie apart and is never merged into it, and any_low and any_high give a range for any phrasing where 5 or more rephrasings were asked. Every point carries available_at, when this reader could first have seen it. as_of reads the results exactly as they stood at a past moment (no later run and no later re-reading of an answer), and first_release=true reads every answer as first published; both need a free key (the historical reads are what a backtest pulls, and a key says who is pulling). Versions are continued onto the latest unless version is given. (GET /api/v1/polls/{id}/results)

as_of.description: Read as things stood at this moment (RFC 3339): only runs this reader could have seen by then, each answer as it was read then. Needs a key.

first_release.description: true: each answer's first reading, as first published, rather than its latest. Needs a key.

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).

version.description: One version only. Default: every version continued onto the latest.

view.description: pooled combines a question's wordings, each once; by-wording keeps them apart.

name: get_results
title: Get a poll's results
